auth_users_customer_role_check.name: auth_users_customer_role_check
auth_users_customer_role_check.value: ("auth_users"."role" = 'user' and "auth_users"."customer_id" is not null) or ("auth_users"."role" in ('super_admin', 'admin') and "auth_users"."customer_id" is null)

jifeng_connections_authorized_status_pro.name: jifeng_connections_authorized_status_provenance_check
jifeng_connections_authorized_status_pro.value: "jifeng_connections"."status" not in ('AUTHORIZED', 'RESOURCE_SELECTION_REQUIRED', 'READY_DISABLED', 'ENABLED', 'REFRESH_REQUIRED') or ("jifeng_connections"."authorized_at" is not null and "jifeng_connections"."authorized_by_admin_user_id" is not null)

jifeng_connections_enabled_status_proven.name: jifeng_connections_enabled_status_provenance_check
jifeng_connections_enabled_status_proven.value: "jifeng_connections"."status" <> 'ENABLED' or ("jifeng_connections"."authorized_at" is not null and "jifeng_connections"."authorized_by_admin_user_id" is not null and "jifeng_connections"."fulfillment_enabled_at" is not null and "jifeng_connections"."fulfillment_enabled_by_admin_user_id" is not null)

fulfillment_orders_paid_mode_required.name: fulfillment_orders_paid_mode_required
fulfillment_orders_paid_mode_required.value: "fulfillment_orders"."status" not in ('PAID_PENDING_FULFILLMENT', 'FULFILLING', 'SHIPPED', 'FULFILLMENT_EXCEPTION') or "fulfillment_orders"."payment_mode" is not null

order_shipments_logistics_fee_currency_p.name: order_shipments_logistics_fee_currency_pair
order_shipments_logistics_fee_currency_p.value: "order_shipments"."logistics_fee_minor" is null or "order_shipments"."logistics_currency" is not null

settlement_batches_terminal_reason_requi.name: settlement_batches_terminal_reason_required
settlement_batches_terminal_reason_requi.value: "settlement_batches"."status" not in ('REJECTED', 'WITHDRAWN', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') or nullif(trim("settlement_batches"."status_reason"), '') is not null

settlement_payment_claims_review_details.name: settlement_payment_claims_review_details_required
settlement_payment_claims_review_details.value: ("settlement_payment_claims"."status" <> 'APPROVED' or ("settlement_payment_claims"."reviewed_at" is not null and "settlement_payment_claims"."reviewed_by_admin_user_id" is not null)) and ("settlement_payment_claims"."status" <> 'REJECTED' or "settlement_payment_claims"."reviewed_at" is not null)

settlement_payment_claims_withdrawal_det.name: settlement_payment_claims_withdrawal_details_required
settlement_payment_claims_withdrawal_det.value: "settlement_payment_claims"."status" <> 'WITHDRAWN' or ("settlement_payment_claims"."withdrawn_at" is not null and nullif(trim("settlement_payment_claims"."withdrawal_reason"), '') is not null)

wallet_holds_release_details_required.name: wallet_holds_release_details_required
wallet_holds_release_details_required.value: "wallet_holds"."status" <> 'RELEASED' or ("wallet_holds"."released_at" is not null and nullif(trim("wallet_holds"."release_reason"), '') is not null)

wallet_transactions_order_link_matches_t.name: wallet_transactions_order_link_matches_type
wallet_transactions_order_link_matches_t.value: ("wallet_transactions"."transaction_type" in ('ORDER_DEBIT', 'ORDER_REFUND') and "wallet_transactions"."order_id" is not null) or ("wallet_transactions"."transaction_type" in ('ADMIN_CREDIT', 'ADMIN_DEBIT') and "wallet_transactions"."order_id" is null)
